cover.report_type: Interim Report: June 20 (for the period ending June 19, 2006)

_meta.notes: The form prints the candidate as 'SIMARJIT S. GILL'; the clerk listing says 'Sim Gill' (same person). Line 3 is written without a thousands comma (5459.60) - kept verbatim. District Number box holds the word COUNTYWIDE. Neither amendment box is checked. On-form arithmetic is internally consistent.

itemized.itemized_pages_A: 7-9 (attachment); the pre-printed Schedule A form page is 3 and carries no lines

expenditures.detail: delta 0.04 - stated 12,844.40 vs transcribed 12,844.36. Localised to Schedule B page 2 (PDF p5), whose rows sum to 5,359.85 against a printed subtotal of 5,359.89; the other two Schedule B pages gate exactly (5,079.63 and 2,404.88) and the three printed subtotals sum to the printed total exactly. The 0.04 is a single cents digit somewhere in p5 that survived escalation to 1600 and 2400 dpi; NO row was adjusted to close it.

itemized.page_subtotal_gates: p4 (Sched B pg 1) rows 5,079.63 = printed subtotal 5,079.63 - gate fires exactly. p5 (Sched B pg 2) rows 5,359.85 vs printed subtotal 5,359.89 - GATE DOES NOT FIRE, residual 0.04, both figures named, no row adjusted. p6 (Sched B pg 3) rows 2,404.88 = printed subtotal 2,404.88 - gate fires exactly. The printed TOTAL EXPENDITURES MADE 12,844.40 equals the sum of the three PRINTED subtotals exactly. Schedule A's three attachment pages print NO subtotals at all, but their rows sum to the stated total 28,251.00 exactly - gate fires at the schedule level.
itemized.escalation_note: p5 amount column in two 800 dpi bands; then five individual cents groups at 1600 dpi (45, 200, 312, 371, 135) and three more at 2400 dpi (249, 303/262, 258) hunting the 0.04 - this is what turned 200.00 into 200.50 and left 135.8? doubtful
itemized.notes: MIXED FORM: the pre-printed Schedule A page (PDF p3) has its ONE filled row entirely SCRIBBLED OUT (date, name, address, occupation and amount all struck through in ink, illegible and cancelled - NOT transcribed, it is a voided entry) and the next row instead reads 'See Attachment for list of Contributors.'; its SUBTOTAL and TOTAL cells are blank. The actual contributions are on three LANDSCAPE spreadsheet attachment pages (PDF p7-p9), which poppler renders horizontally with no rotation needed. THE ATTACHMENT'S ADDRESS BLOCK IS REDACTED: a white box covers the Address/City/State/Zip columns for every INDIVIDUAL donor, while three ORGANISATIONAL rows were deliberately left visible (USINPAC of Chantilly VA; Teamsters Local 222 of Salt Lake City UT; The Target Group of Salt Lake City UT). Redacted rows carry blank city/state and say 'redacted' in the note - that is different from a filer leaving the field empty. Only city and state are recorded for the three visible rows; no street address is written anywhere. The attachment prints First Name and Last Name in separate columns and donor_raw joins them in that printed order (one row prints 'Boyer / Jarvis', which the same filer's later report writes as 'Jarvis / Boyer'). ONE MALFORMED DATE: '5/182006' (Daniel Berman) - left blank + needs_review, verbatim in the note. Schedule B uses the pre-printed form across three pages with the raised-superscript cents convention throughout. The Target Group appears on BOTH sides (a $1,000 contribution on 6/2/2006 and consulting payments out) and James Seaman, the campaign manager, is the recipient of many reimbursements. The form's own page numbering is 'Page N of 8' against a 9-page PDF.
